description: This file contains a utility class 'UtilValidate' providing various static methods for data validation, including checks for email, URL, date, time, credit card, social security number, ZIP code, state code, and phone number validation. It also includes helper methods for string manipulation and checks on different data types.

classes.name: UtilValidate
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for validating various data types and formats such as email, URL, date, credit cards, phone numbers, zip codes, and more.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if various types of objects (String, Collection, Map, IsEmpty, CharSequence) are empty or null.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if various objects are not empty or null.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Determines if an object is a String.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a String contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: stripCharsInBag
methods.description: Removes all characters in a given 'bag' string from the input string.

methods.name: isInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string is a non-signed integer.

methods.name: isSignedInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string is a signed integer.

methods.name: isSignedLong
methods.description: Checks if a string is a signed long integer.

methods.name: isPositiveInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer greater than zero.

methods.name: isNonnegativeInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer greater than or equal to zero.

methods.name: isNegativeInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer less than zero.

methods.name: isNonpositiveInteger
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: isFloat
methods.description: Checks if a string is an unsigned floating point number.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if a string is a double-precision floating point number.

methods.name: isSignedFloat
methods.description: Checks if a string is a signed or unsigned floating point number.

methods.name: isSignedDouble
methods.description: Checks if a string is a signed or unsigned double-precision number.

methods.name: isAlphabetic
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only alphabetic characters.

methods.name: isAlphanumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only alphanumeric characters.

methods.name: isSSN
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid U.S. Social Security Number.

methods.name: isZIPCode
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid U.S. ZIP code (5 or 9 digits).

methods.name: isContiguousZipCode
methods.description: Validates if a ZIP code is in the contiguous U.S. range.

methods.name: isStateCode
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid U.S. state code.

methods.name: isContiguousStateCode
methods.description: Checks if a state code is among the contiguous U.S. states.

methods.name: isEmail
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper email address.

methods.name: isEmailList
methods.description: Validates if a comma-separated list contains valid email addresses.

methods.name: isUrlInString
methods.description: Checks if a string contains '://', indicating a URL.

methods.name: isUrlInStringAndDoesNotStartByComponentProtocol
methods.description: Checks if a string contains '://', but does not start with 'component://'.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Validates if a string is a well-formed URL using Apache Commons UrlValidator.

methods.name: isYear
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid year (2 or 4 digits).

methods.name: isIntegerInRange
methods.description: Checks if a string represents an integer within a specified range.

methods.name: isMonth
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid month (1-12).

methods.name: isDay
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid day (1-31).

methods.name: daysInFebruary
methods.description: Returns the number of days in February for a given year.

methods.name: isHour
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid hour (0-23).

methods.name: isMinute
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid minute (0-59).

methods.name: isSecond
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid second (0-59).

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Checks if provided year, month, and day form a valid date.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Validates if a string in MM/DD/YYYY format is a valid date.

methods.name: isDateAfterToday
methods.description: Checks if a date string is after the current date.

methods.name: isDateBeforeToday
methods.description: Checks if a date string is before the current date.

methods.name: isDateBeforeNow
methods.description: Checks if a Timestamp is before the current timestamp.

methods.name: isDateAfterNow
methods.description: Checks if a Timestamp is after the current timestamp.

methods.name: isTime
methods.description: Checks if hour, minute, second strings form a valid time.

methods.name: isTime
methods.description: Validates if a string in HH:MM:SS format is a valid time.

methods.name: isDiscover
